newsitem.title: USA: Major New York hospitals call off merger.
newsitem.headline: Major New York hospitals call off merger.

text.p: The Mt. Sinai Medical Center, New York University and New York University Medical Center said Friday they have called off the merger of their medical schools, medical centers, and health care systems.
The hopsitals also said they will continue to collaborate in areas where they cooperated before the merger talks, as well as in new ones discovered during negotiations.
